title: Tech Note: ACI’s 1998 FAQ Pt 1: Fixing Problems

historical_commentary.text: This FAQ document captures a snapshot of the most common problems 4D users faced in 1998, reflecting the v6 era's typical issues around installation, configuration, and platform-specific quirks on classic Mac OS and Windows 95/98/NT. While the specific problems are outdated, FAQ-style troubleshooting documents remain a valuable support format.
related_updates: Most problems documented here relate to classic Mac OS and Windows 95/98/NT environments that are no longer supported
4D's installation and configuration processes have been modernized significantly
